status: Dated race-day editorial research. Some races may have started by the time this card is viewed; for those races these are retrospective summaries of preview opinions, not predictions recorded before the jump. Check official results, scratchings, ground and market terms before drawing conclusions.
method_note: Source-backed editorial order, not a calibrated model or a tested betting edge. Cases and risks are paraphrased from named pre-race previews and checked against Racing NSW acceptances and scratchings. Barriers are original draws, not necessarily effective stalls after withdrawals. No bookmaker prices are stored here.

racing_nsw_preview.title: Racing NSW · Ray Hickson's Big Dance Day preview

racing_nsw_acceptances.title: Racing NSW · Royal Randwick final acceptances

races.name: Midway Handicap
races.question: Can Cabbucio finish strongly again at the same track and trip if the tempo is steadier?

watchlist.case: Close Randwick 1800 m third last start; drawn to find cover with an apprentice claim.
watchlist.risk: That prior run had a strong tempo, and the effective carried weight rises from it.

watchlist.case: Won decisively over 1600 m at Kembla after racing near the lead; could control a calmer tempo.
watchlist.risk: Steps up in class and another 200 m.

watchlist.case: Earlier Randwick mile second supplies a useful local form line.
watchlist.risk: Did not finish as strongly as Cabbucio in their last shared race and carries more weight.

races.name: TAB Highway Handicap
races.question: Will the expected early speed give Flirtation a run at the leaders late?

watchlist.case: Three-start profile includes a wet-track win; gate 5 can let her settle behind the likely fast pace.
watchlist.risk: Resumes after a break and has limited exposed form.

watchlist.case: Wide-margin first-up Muswellbrook win and an inside draw suit a horse expected to race forward.
watchlist.risk: Rises to a stronger Highway field; the rail can be a trap if pace gathers outside.

watchlist.case: Had limited room at key stages at Tamworth and drops substantially in weight.
watchlist.risk: Needs a clear path through a crowded sprint field.

races.name: Alinta Energy Handicap
races.question: Does the rise from 1100 m to 1300 m help Hellenic Belle finish over the top?

watchlist.case: Fast-finishing Rosehill second when resuming; drops from stronger company and draws handily.
watchlist.risk: The added 200 m still has to be proved this preparation.

watchlist.case: Won first-up at Kembla and has form at this distance; Nash Rawiller rides.
watchlist.risk: Gate 17 and 61 kg could demand early work or a wide trip.

watchlist.case: A previous Highway win and a drop from tougher open grade put the last run in context.
watchlist.risk: Top weight remains a concern even with the apprentice claim.

races.name: Toyota Forklifts Handicap
races.question: Can Man Of Worth improve second-up with 100 m more distance and a low draw?

watchlist.case: Third on resumption at Randwick; 1500 m and gate 2 offer a plausible second-up improvement path.
watchlist.risk: He weakened late last time and is a short-price type in many previews; price must be checked separately.

watchlist.case: The longer trip should suit better than the sharp Kosciuszko run; has a Randwick mile placing.
watchlist.risk: Carries 60.5 kg before the apprentice claim and needs a rebound.

watchlist.case: Wyong winner returns after a freshen-up with a low weight and inside gate.
watchlist.risk: The jump from provincial benchmark grade to this BM88 is substantial.

races.name: Big Dance
races.question: Will a genuine mile pace bring Churchill’s Choice into range, or favour a forward runner?

watchlist.case: Won a Hawkesbury Cup at a mile with a strong finish; third-up and 53 kg suit a late run.
watchlist.risk: She can lose contact in the middle stages and needs a genuine pace plus a clear route.

watchlist.case: Won the Alan Brown from near the front and has a Randwick 1600 m win; gate 2 supports a low-effort position.
watchlist.risk: May face more early pressure than at Rosehill and may not control the tempo.

watchlist.case: Two solid runs back and a near-pace style make him a credible tactical alternative.
watchlist.risk: Has to improve enough to turn recent placings into a win in a deep field.

races.name: Barn Dance
races.question: Can Lord Remlap get a more efficient trip from gate 3 than in the Kosciuszko?

watchlist.case: The Kosciuszko run involved a wide, rearward trip; gate 3 and 54 kg suggest a cleaner route here.
watchlist.risk: He still needs to settle and finish better than he did in that stronger race.

watchlist.case: Recent Queensland placings and an earlier third behind subsequent stakes performers support his consistency.
watchlist.risk: Yet to show that form produces a win in this field.

watchlist.case: Won after a break at Scone despite 63 kg and a wide draw; now drops markedly in weight.
watchlist.risk: His get-back style may need room and a suitable pace at 1300 m.

races.name: Little Dance
races.question: Can the class runner overcome gate 22 and 62 kg, or will a better-drawn rival get the first run?

watchlist.case: Recent placings behind Skyhook and Formal Display make him the class reference.
watchlist.risk: Gate 22 and 62 kg demand an efficient early decision; his last Randwick finish was below expectations.

watchlist.case: Four straight top-two finishes and gate 1 create a possible economical route at the mile.
watchlist.risk: May need room at the right time if buried inside.

watchlist.case: Two strong placings after a long break and a later trial suggest fitness may improve; draws more tractably than the topweight.
watchlist.risk: Faded late over a mile last start and must prove he finishes it strongly today.

races.name: Asahi Super Dry Choisir Handicap
races.question: Will the sprint favour Kerguelen’s late finish or Wanaruah’s more tactical speed?

watchlist.case: Strong closing third at Warwick Farm on resumption; the extra 100 m and gate 1 can help if a gap appears.
watchlist.risk: A back-half runner can become boxed in from the rail in an 1100 m race.

watchlist.case: Recent Randwick 1200 m win and prior 1100 m win here show both course and trip suitability.
watchlist.risk: Rises in benchmark and carries more weight even after the claim.

watchlist.case: Placed behind Wanaruah before being tested in stronger Group company.
watchlist.risk: Needs to settle better than in his latest Randwick run.

races.name: Quayclean Handicap
races.question: Can Bruce I Am use gate 1 without getting held up if the leaders contest the pace?

watchlist.case: Won at Warwick Farm after resuming and carries just 52.5 kg; gate 1 may yield a soft run behind speed.
watchlist.risk: A closer at 1000 m needs the gaps; this is a class rise.

watchlist.case: Three-win first campaign and enough early pace to lead if the crossing cost is modest.
watchlist.risk: Has not raced for months and may face pressure from another leader.

watchlist.case: Won first run for the new stable and receives a sizeable weight drop.
watchlist.risk: Returns to 1000 m and must repeat that new-stable performance.

races.name: The Agency Real Estate Handicap
races.question: Is Enamorada’s class enough at 1200 m first-up if she settles in the back half?

watchlist.case: Strong Randwick win over Golden Eagle runners Mr Miller and Night Agent is the leading class line; Nash Rawiller rides.
watchlist.risk: Resumes after a lengthy break and shortens to 1200 m, so the early position matters.

watchlist.case: Worked home late behind Wanaruah and faces a less deep assignment.
watchlist.risk: Needs to improve on the bare second-up result.

watchlist.case: Won first-up at Caulfield and has prior form around Golden Straand.
watchlist.risk: Carries 60 kg into a stronger benchmark race.

news.headline: Randwick remained Good 4 with the rail +2 m
news.detail: Official scratchings sheet lists overcast weather, Good 4 and rail +2 m entire at its 11:54 am publication.
news.impact: Recheck any later downgrade or lane pattern before treating a draw as helpful.

news.headline: Benevac out of R9; Bruce I Am remains active
news.detail: Racing NSW lists Benevac among R9 scratchings. The official preview's current R9 selection is Bruce I Am.
news.impact: Do not include Benevac in a live R9 prediction or combination.

news.headline: I’ve Bean Tryin’ out of the Little Dance
news.detail: The R7 runner is scratched on the official sheet, although older previews may still list it among the dangers.
news.impact: Use an active alternative such as Fukubana or I’mintowin in the editorial watchlist.
